definitions.full: H6229. asaq [ עָשַׂק ] verb Hithpa`el contend (perhaps originally cling to (in strife), compare Arabic cling with love (Lag BN 143 ); Syriac , Ethpa`al be difficult (i.e. indignant, hostile ); Late Hebrew עֲסַק ᵑ7 עָסַק, , busy oneself , Late Hebrew עֵסֶק business, occupation ); — Perfect 3plural עִמּוֺ הִתְעַשְּׂקוּ Gen 26:20 they contended with him .

occurrences.englishText: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” He called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.
